source.author: Kenney
source.note: Kenney tractor, the plain farm tractor (FBX like car-sedan, car-suv and the other kit cars, same kit and pin, with Textures/colormap.png; the plan named the GLB member). The kit's tractor-police and tractor-shovel are the same body with a light bar or a front loader; the plain one reads best as a farm tractor. Scaled to a real compact farm tractor: 2.5 m to the cab roof, which makes it 3.44 m long and 2.09 m wide (a real one is about 3-4 m long). At the kit cars' own scale (car-sedan: 1.3 source units = 1.45 m) it would be only 1.79 m tall, so this is 1.34x their kit scale and sits at real size next to them. Kenney's orange hood and grey cab are recoloured to a red tractor in the indigo script: hood, fenders and cab pillars in the accent red with the sky navy as shade; cab, chassis and grille in sky navy with near-black shade; windows, roof top, front mudguards, bumper and rims in the moon tone (one role, so the rims' texture gradient does not break into slivers); tyres near-black with the navy shade only on faces turned away (threshold -0.3). Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips, as the other kit cars.
